title: Ground Lines
style: Acoustic folk-pop with a slow steady 4/4 pulse, warm strummed guitar, soft piano, and emotional string lifts; verse stays intimate and grounded, pre-chorus opens with airy harmonies, chorus blooms with stacked vocals and a gentle lift. Vocal is close-mic and natural, with light doubles on the hook, a few delayed phrase tails, and small hand-percussion accents between lines. Subtle risers, brushed cymbal swells, and a final held chord give it a calm, spacious, polished mix., world, clean, deep, acoustic, steady, warm, slow, flat, simple, classic
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The desk is clean, the margins straight
The paper crane rests by the gate
A glass of water on the wood
We built a space where focus stood
No hidden strings, no distant code
Just steady steps along the road
The crayons sketch a tiny door
But both our feet are on the floor

[Chorus]
And the rhythm is yours to hold
In the quiet, in the bold
The screen is flat, the world is wide
You are the captain of the tide
Take a breath and let it align
Walking a completely steady line
(steady line)
(steady line)

[Verse 2]
The music plays an upbeat track
You take a walk and you come back
The wheat is gone, the sugar denied
Just honest strength kept deep inside
A pen pal writing from afar
Beneath a very real star
We count the words and clear the space
At a completely human pace

[Chorus]
And the rhythm is yours to hold
In the quiet, in the bold
The screen is flat, the world is wide
You are the captain of the tide
Take a breath and let it align
Walking a completely steady line
(steady line)
(steady line)

[Bridge]
The crane is still, the room is calm
A steady hand, a open palm
The session closes, the song is done
Enjoy the fading afternoon sun

[Outro]
The crane is still, the room is calm
A steady hand, a open palm
The session closes, the song is done
Enjoy the fading afternoon sun
